options.counterfactual: Every faithful normalized 2-quasitrace on a finite AW*-factor is exhaustive: if positive elements have all finite partial sums bounded by 1, their quasitrace values tend to zero.
options.approach: Apply exhaustivity directly to b_n=a_{n+1}-a_n. Their partial sums are bounded by 1, so their constant quasitrace value must be zero, proving that the requested set is empty.
